# parent commit

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:parentCommit`](gmeow-parentCommit.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/parentCommit>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

A parent commit from which this commit was derived — the provenance spine of the commit DAG. Non-functional: a merge commit has multiple parents; the initial commit has none.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Commit`](../classes/gmeow-Commit.md) -> [`gmeow:Commit`](../classes/gmeow-Commit.md)
